techtree.space.docstring: Base node for spaceflight milestone systems.
techtree.space.name: Space Program Base

techtree.space.sounding.docstring: Tier 1: Basic uncrewed atmospheric flight validating structural and motor foundations.
techtree.space.sounding.name: Sounding Rocket

techtree.space.orbital.docstring: Tier 2: Achievement of stable orbit via high-velocity engines and telemetry tracking.
techtree.space.orbital.name: Orbital Flight

techtree.space.lifesupport.docstring: Tier 2: Engineering systems managing pressurized cabins, carbon scrubbing, and heat mitigation.
techtree.space.lifesupport.name: Life Support Systems

techtree.space.manned.docstring: Tier 3 (Diamond A): Sustaining human life safely inside a functional orbit and executing a safe atmospheric reentry.
techtree.space.manned.name: Manned Orbital Flight

techtree.space.rendezvous.docstring: Tier 3 (Diamond B): Precision relative telemetry and active thruster handling to bring two separate craft together in space.
techtree.space.rendezvous.name: Orbital Rendezvous

techtree.space.lunar.docstring: Tier 4: Deep space execution covering interlunar transit, descent, and return staging.
techtree.space.lunar.name: Moon Landing
